title: Motion pattern lab (source of the Motion Patterns pack)
summary: The comps every Motion Patterns preset and template was built and verified in: preset test benches, text staggers, two-tone wipe, colour iris, lower third, logo stamp reveal, bar chart, and a recipes comp (push, zoom-through, card stack, highlight sweep).
use_when: You want to see a pattern working before using it, copy one comp's objects into a job, or rebuild a template with comp_to_template.py after changing it.

comps: MP LT Accent bar (template source; the old LT Lower Third comp)
Preset bench (nine object presets applied by preset.apply)
Text Lab (seven staggered text presets applied by preset.apply)
RECIPES (push 0-48, zoom-through 48-94, card stack 100-150, highlight sweep 150-200)
Template Test (the two templates' comps placed as instances)
FX Blur Glow Soft, FX Glow grid, FX Shadow Gradient Stroke, FX Basement Ropes, FX Glow calibration
MAP UAE emirates, MAP Dubai base, MAP Dubai zoom

carvercat_version: regenerated as carvercat/2 by ai/scripts/motion/motion_patterns_lab.py and verified on Carvercat 0.1.8.1 (rev 1127), 2026-11-07
copy_notes: Clip ids restart at clip_1 in every comp. Rename ids before nesting several of these comps in one master (references/app/performance.md).
The pack itself is library/templates/motion-patterns; docs in ai/patterns/.
